reason: Max drawdown values are negative. The base contract field name candidate_minus_baseline_max_drawdown_pp_max was sign-ambiguous and could incorrectly reject a large improvement. R1 freezes the intended invariant before any candidate economics: compare absolute drawdown magnitudes and permit at most 0.01 absolute worsening versus the matched BRRK baseline.

replacement_semantics.max_drawdown_improvement_abs: abs(baseline_max_drawdown) - abs(candidate_max_drawdown); positive means candidate improves drawdown
